animations.description: Stands precisely, breathing softly with her hands at rest.
Holds still and makes small eye movements while listening.
Shifts her weight and lets her shoulders sag briefly.
Stands with relaxed shoulders and unguarded hands.
Walks with measured steps, a level head and restrained arm swing.
Takes quick, short steps while trying to remain composed.
Shifts forward and takes the first deliberate walking step.
Shortens her final step and settles neatly into stillness.
Turns ninety degrees left using two small planted steps.
Turns ninety degrees right using two small planted steps.
Takes one cautious backward step without looking away.
Moves one step left to give someone room.
Moves one step right to give someone room.
Climbs stairs carefully, lifting her shoes clear of each tread.
Descends stairs with controlled steps and a slight downward glance.
Waits beside a lift, checks the indicator and settles again.
Steps across the lift threshold and turns to face the doors.
Leaves the lift and pauses to choose her direction.
Places her key in the lock, turns it and withdraws it.
Presses the door open and follows it through.
Pulls the door toward herself and steps clear of its swing.
Holds an open door while watching for the other person.
Draws the door shut and checks that the latch catches.
Turns the key in a closed door and tests the handle.
Knocks twice, lowers her hand and waits.
Opens her posture slightly to acknowledge a visitor.
Looks at the speaker, tilting her head very slightly.
Narrows her eyes and holds a thought before answering.
Speaks with small, controlled hand movements and steady eye contact.
Leans forward slightly and underlines a point with one hand.
Gives one small, considered nod.
Shakes her head once and returns to direct eye contact.
Separates an idea into two careful, open-handed gestures.
Raises one finger, corrects a detail and lowers it.
Looks aside briefly and closes her hands to end the subject.
Lets a small, reluctant smile reach her eyes before it fades.
Checks the edge of the room and quickly looks back.
Nudges her spectacles into exact alignment.
Touches the pencil behind her ear to confirm it is there.
Pulls one cuff straight and smooths its repaired seam.
Traces a short invisible caption with two precise finger movements.
Begins to caption something, catches herself and lowers her hand.
Remains motionless for four seconds, fighting the urge to fill the silence.
Breathes out slowly and lets her shoulders soften.
Checks the chair, sits carefully and arranges her skirt.
Sits upright with small breathing and eye movements.
Writes a short line, pauses and resumes with precise pencil strokes.
Reads across a page while tracking a line with one finger.
Lifts a page corner and turns it without disturbing the stack.
Erases a small passage and brushes the crumbs aside.
Taps a stack of papers into a perfectly aligned rectangle.
Pushes away from the desk and rises without hurrying.
Bends through the hips and knees to lift a small low object.
Lowers an object carefully and releases it before straightening.
Walks holding a laundry basket close to her body.
Flattens a garment and folds its edges into a neat rectangle.
Unfolds a letter, reads it and holds it a moment longer.
Lifts off her hat and lowers it carefully to her side.
Places her hat on her head and levels the brim.
Sits on the bed, turns and lowers herself onto the pillow.
Starts to answer, tightens her hands and loses the sentence.
Becomes still as a new understanding reaches her face.
Meets the other person's eyes and allows the pause to remain blank.
Offers a small nod and an open hand, without a practiced speech.
Takes three quick steps, checks herself and turns back.
Flinches once and searches for the source of the interruption.
Draws back slightly and protects the papers against her body.
Parts her lips to speak, stops and looks for another beginning.
Keeps facing the listener while blinking back tears.
Swallows, straightens a cuff and steadies her breathing.
Sleeps with slow breathing and occasional small natural movements.
Wakes, gathers herself and swings her feet to the floor.
